description: The agent must: (1) Read expedition_scenarios.json to understand all 5 scenarios. (2) For S1 (roof rack load securing), recommend the Trucker's Hitch for mechanical advantage tensioning AND flag that 480 kg on a 2000 kg rope with 25-50% knot strength reduction and 1/5-1/10 working load ratio likely exceeds safe working load. (3) For S2 (adjustable guy lines), recommend the Taut-line Hitch AND warn about polypropylene being slippery requiring extra wraps. (4) For S3 (joining 12mm manila to 6mm polyester), recommend the Sheet Bend, note it must be a double sheet bend due to different diameters, and include the critical detail that both free ends must exit on the same side. (5) For S4 (pole structure), recommend Square Lashing for right-angle joints (starting with a clove hitch) AND Diagonal Lashing for bracing (critically: starting with a timber hitch around BOTH poles, not a clove hitch), and must mention frapping turns. (6) For S5 (square knot for load bearing), EXPLICITLY reject the square knot for load-bearing joins with a warning it will capsize/fail, and recommend a Sheet Bend or Double Fisherman's knot instead. The output must be saved as rope_work_guide.json.
